scope: Balanced all-replica execution smoke test on the published-Miller TREX1 8-oxoG protein-DNA lesion set. No source coordinates or private paths are distributed.

input_lineage.dataset_description: Published-Miller/OL21 TREX1 lesion package: three protein-DNA 8-oxoG replicas with Mg ions
input_lineage.connectivity_method: The matching OpenMM System XML supplied harmonic/custom bond terms and constraints; no residue-template or distance-based bond inference was used.

execution.selection_contract: Uniform deterministic sampling over each replica's full 1,000-frame aggregate history, including its first and last frames.

shared_planner_refactor_check.scope: Read-only source-count and deterministic selection-plan check only; no estimator was rerun.

scaling_contract.full_raw_coverage: Declare all 30 source segments, set frame_selection.maximum_frames_per_replica to 10000, and set maximum_evaluated_frames to at least 30000.
scaling_contract.resource_limited_coverage: Use the same uniform per-replica policy with a predeclared smaller budget; the JSON report records total source frames and selected coverage for every replica and segment.
scaling_contract.dcd_efficiency: For non-continuous periodic policies, unselected DCD coordinate payloads are record-envelope validated but not decoded or reconstructed. Continuous unwrapping deliberately processes every raw frame to maintain image history.

required_caveats: Thirty all-replica aggregate frames are a technical integration smoke test, not a convergence, sampling, or biological validation.
The 30,000 raw 10-ps source frames were authenticated from the package inventory but were not all evaluated in this bounded local run.
Mg ions were authenticated in the topology but are excluded from hydrogen-bond donor/acceptor roles; their coordination belongs to the ion-geometry module.
No independent water-bridge implementation was compared against this real lesion subset.
Completed execution does not establish water residence kinetics, energetic importance, affinity, causality, or a biological conclusion.
